Class CreateInitialSolutionsDoubleParameter

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.parameter.Parameter<String>
org.uma.evolver.parameter.type.CategoricalParameter
org.uma.evolver.parameter.catalogue.createinitialsolutionsparameter.CreateInitialSolutionsParameter<org.uma.jmetal.solution.doublesolution.DoubleSolution>
org.uma.evolver.parameter.catalogue.createinitialsolutionsparameter.CreateInitialSolutionsDoubleParameter
public class CreateInitialSolutionsDoubleParameter extends CreateInitialSolutionsParameter<org.uma.jmetal.solution.doublesolution.DoubleSolution>
A parameter for creating initial double solutions in evolutionary algorithms. This parameter defines the strategy used to generate the initial population of double solutions.

Supported strategies (compatible with jMetal 7.0):

  • DEFAULT_STRATEGY: Creates random double solutions using RandomSolutionsCreation
  • SCATTER_SEARCH: Creates solutions using ScatterSearchSolutionsCreation with configurable reference set size
  • LATIN_HYPERCUBE_SAMPLING: Creates solutions using Latin Hypercube Sampling for better space coverage
  • SOBOL: Creates solutions using Sobol quasi-random sequences for low-discrepancy uniform coverage
  • CAUCHY: Creates solutions using Cauchy distribution with heavy tails for intensive local exploitation and distant jumps
  • OPPOSITION_BASED: Creates pairs of solutions (original + opposite) for enhanced exploration

The strategies are designed to provide different levels of initial population diversity:

  • Random: Fast generation with uniform random distribution
  • Scatter Search: Enhanced diversity through reference set-based generation
  • Latin Hypercube: Optimal space coverage, particularly effective for high-dimensional problems
  • Sobol: Quasi-random low-discrepancy sequences providing superior uniform coverage
  • Cauchy: Heavy-tailed distribution for problems with massive local optima, balancing local exploitation and distant exploration
  • Opposition-Based: Explores opposite regions of search space for better exploration

Example usage: 


CreateInitialSolutionsDoubleParameter param = new CreateInitialSolutionsDoubleParameter(
    List.of("default", "scatterSearch", "latinHypercubeSampling", "sobol", "cauchy", "oppositionBased"));
param.setValue("sobol");
SolutionsCreation<DoubleSolution> strategy = param.getCreateInitialSolutionsStrategy(problem, 100);
List<DoubleSolution> initialPopulation = strategy.create();
Since:
jMetal 7.0

  • Field Details

    • DEFAULT_STRATEGY

      public static final String DEFAULT_STRATEGY
      Strategy that creates random double solutions using uniform distribution.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • SCATTER_SEARCH

      public static final String SCATTER_SEARCH
      Strategy that creates solutions using scatter search with a reference set. This provides good diversity in the initial population by using a reference set to guide the generation of diverse solutions.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • LATIN_HYPERCUBE_SAMPLING

      public static final String LATIN_HYPERCUBE_SAMPLING
      Strategy that uses Latin Hypercube Sampling to ensure good coverage of the search space. This is particularly useful for high-dimensional problems as it guarantees better space-filling properties compared to random sampling.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • SOBOL

      public static final String SOBOL
      Strategy that uses Sobol quasi-random sequences for solution creation. Provides low-discrepancy sequences that fill the search space more evenly than pseudo-random numbers. Uses Cranley-Patterson rotation for randomization while preserving low-discrepancy properties. Excellent for uniform coverage.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • CAUCHY

      public static final String CAUCHY
      Strategy that uses Cauchy distribution for solution creation. The heavy-tailed distribution concentrates solutions near the center of the search space but occasionally generates solutions far away. Particularly useful for landscapes with massive local optima, where both intensive local exploitation and distant jumps are needed.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • OPPOSITION_BASED

      public static final String OPPOSITION_BASED
      Strategy that creates pairs of solutions (original + opposite) by mirroring each variable across the center of its bounds. Enhances exploration by ensuring opposite regions of the search space are covered.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

      public CreateInitialSolutionsDoubleParameter(List<String> validValues)
      Creates a new CreateInitialSolutionsDoubleParameter with the specified valid values.
      Parameters:
      validValues - A list of valid strategy names for creating initial double solutions. Should typically include at least DEFAULT_STRATEGY, and optionally SCATTER_SEARCH, LATIN_HYPERCUBE_SAMPLING, SOBOL, CAUCHY, and/or OPPOSITION_BASED.

  • Method Details

    • getCreateInitialSolutionsStrategy

      public org.uma.jmetal.component.catalogue.common.solutionscreation.SolutionsCreation<org.uma.jmetal.solution.doublesolution.DoubleSolution> getCreateInitialSolutionsStrategy(org.uma.jmetal.problem.Problem<org.uma.jmetal.solution.doublesolution.DoubleSolution> problem, int populationSize)
      Creates and returns a SolutionsCreation strategy for double solutions based on the current parameter value.

      This method uses improved error checking with jMetal 7.0's Check utility and provides better error messages for debugging.

      Specified by:
      getCreateInitialSolutionsStrategy in class CreateInitialSolutionsParameter<org.uma.jmetal.solution.doublesolution.DoubleSolution>
      Parameters:
      problem - The double problem for which to create initial solutions
      populationSize - The number of solutions to create
      Returns:
      A configured SolutionsCreation strategy for double solutions
      Throws:
      org.uma.jmetal.util.errorchecking.JMetalException - if the current value does not match any known strategy
      IllegalArgumentException - if problem is null, not a DoubleProblem (for some strategies), or populationSize is not positive

    • getCreateInitialSolutionsStrategy

      public org.uma.jmetal.component.catalogue.common.solutionscreation.SolutionsCreation<org.uma.jmetal.solution.doublesolution.DoubleSolution> getCreateInitialSolutionsStrategy(org.uma.jmetal.problem.Problem<org.uma.jmetal.solution.doublesolution.DoubleSolution> problem, int populationSize, int referenceSetSize)
      Creates a SolutionsCreation strategy with a custom reference set size for scatter search. This method provides additional configuration options for the scatter search strategy.
      Parameters:
      problem - The double problem for which to create initial solutions
      populationSize - The number of solutions to create
      referenceSetSize - The reference set size for scatter search (ignored for other strategies)
      Returns:
      A configured SolutionsCreation strategy for double solutions
      Throws:
      org.uma.jmetal.util.errorchecking.JMetalException - if the current value does not match any known strategy
      IllegalArgumentException - if parameters are invalid
